responsibility: Declares the main item-lowering visitor for Rust AST-to-HIR conversion, along with a helper lowerer for simple paths. ASTLoweringItem provides the entry point used to translate AST::Item nodes into concrete HIR::Item subclasses for modules, type and data declarations, functions, traits, impls, and extern blocks, while ASTLoweringSimplePath builds HIR::SimplePath and SimplePathSegment objects used by visibility and other path-bearing metadata. This header is the interface layer for item-level lowering rather than the implementation of specific expression or type translations.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ASTLoweringItem visitor and ASTLoweringSimplePath helper used for item-oriented lowering, while rust-ast-lower-item.cc contains the actual translation code for specific item kinds and simple-path construction.
